definitions.explanation: Water with no salt in it, as opposed to seawater; also plain water with nothing added.

examples.japanese: {真水|まみず}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}いだ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真水|まみず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャワーを{浴|あ}びる→シャワーを浴びる：26379_shawaawoabiru⟧。
examples.english: After swimming in the sea, I rinse off in a freshwater shower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漂流|ひょうりゅう}→漂流：13338_hyouryuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧、⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真水|まみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことだ。
examples.english: For someone adrift at sea, the most important thing is securing fresh water.

notes:
The everyday word, used when the point is that there is no salt: after the sea, in cooking, for rinsing gear.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{淡水|たんすい}→淡水：04508_tansui⟧: fresh water as a category (lakes, rivers, freshwater fish); more technical
- ⟦{海水|かいすい}→海水：13334_kaisui⟧: seawater
